blind.description: A stylized fantasy blacksmith forge constructed from chunky grey masonry stone blocks. It features a lower stone base with a small arched ash cleanout at the front bottom, a central fire pit filled with dark coals and grey ash, and a front stone lip upon which rests a pair of iron blacksmith tongs and a long hammer or poker. Two stone pillars support a wide stone lintel, above which sits a sloping pyramidal terracotta-red hood stained with dark soot in the center, topped by a rectangular stone chimney opening. The back and sides are solid coursed stone. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylistically modeled with clean hand-painted textures, standing flat on its own base without any added plinth or floating artifacts.
blind.from_above: Shows a rectangular footprint dominated by a sloped terracotta-red hip hood with a hollow rectangular chimney collar at the center top. The front stone ledge extends forward, revealing the iron tongs and hammer resting on it, alongside the dark coal bed recessed under the hood.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 ft tall (reaching around shoulder height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 ft wide.
